summary: All 45 evaluable genes agreed in direction between the registered risperidone-versus-control result and the authors’ Figure 2, including lower Mc4r expression. These pairs cover 45 of 65 reported DEGs (69.2%), below the 90% coverage threshold. The proposal records a selected-gene comparison without full verification. [Published Figure 2](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8126977/#fig2)
openIssues: Nine reported DEGs lacked readable names, eight named genes had ambiguous directions, and three named genes lacked registered DE rows.
No complete author DESeq2 table was located. Exact effect magnitudes and gene-wise P/FDR agreement remain unassessed.
